4.name: One Year Later...
4.overview: Doty, take this down. I, Taryon Darrington, inventor and bestselling author, have met the most bewildering group of mercenaries in Exandria. A tall brooding one, a short angry one, and far too many pointy ears. They seem… promising?

4.name: Trial by Water
4.overview: Doty, take this down. Antlers has gone off to do something terribly dangerous involving water. Meanwhile, Short Stuff and Jumbo are poking around places they probably shouldn't be. I've arrived with important news. Doty, underline "important."

4.name: The Coronation
4.overview: Doty, take this down. We've gathered in a mountain village for a ceremony. The food is mediocre and my fellow adventurers haven't spoken in a year. Uninvited guests crash the party. Rude. Doty, note that I handled it with grace.

4.name: Taryon, My Wayward Son
4.overview: Doty, take this down. We've traveled to my hometown, which I was hoping to avoid. My family's business is more complicated than I remembered. Short Stuff has strange visions and Four Eyes is playing card games. I had some strong words for my father.

4.name: De Rolo's Eleven
4.overview: Doty, take this down. Four Eyes has devised a plan to break into a library. A LIBRARY. The Head Archivist is terrifying, but couldn't we just ask nicely? Jumbo accidentally did something clever, surprising everyone. Doty, document my contributions.

4.name: We Are His Blood
4.overview: Doty, take this down. Jumbo is telling us a very old, very alarming story. Short Stuff visits family in a quaint town, but something feels… off. A friendly stranger seems a bit too friendly. I have a bad feeling about this one.

4.name: The Ghosts of Whitestone
4.overview: Doty, take this down. I'm told there are secret tunnels beneath the castle. What's down there is ghastly. I elected to stay upstairs the strategic choice. My fellows encountered old horrors and secrets beneath someone of my notoriety.

4.name: The Bard's Lament
4.overview: Doty, take this down. My fellows and I traveled to a distant city to find an old friend. There was music, shouting, and at least one spectacular fight. I, naturally, saved the day. You're welcome. Doty, make sure you got that last part.

4.name: The Temple of Truth
4.overview: Doty, take this down. Things are getting serious. Our brave band is heading somewhere very dark and dangerous, and even I can tell the mood has shifted. Everyone is quieter than usual, which for this group is saying something. Doty, sharpen my sword.

4.name: The Poisoned Ear
4.overview: Doty, take this down. I don't want to talk about this one. Something terrible has happened and my fellow adventurers are shaken. Even Jumbo is quiet. Short Stuff is facing something I don't fully understand. Doty, just… stay close.

4.name: Let the End Begin
4.overview: Doty, take this down. I'd like the record to show that I, Taryon Darrington, did not run. Doty, hold my things.

4.name: The Ascension
4.overview: Doty, take this down. I don't know how to write this one. Everything changed. These ridiculous, extraordinary people gave everything they had. I came looking for an adventure to put in a book. I found something else entirely. Doty… end of chapter.

overview: آنها آشوبگر، بی‌ادب، و از طبقه‌ی متوسط ​​هستند که به مزدورانی اجیر شده تبدیل شده‌اند. وکس ماکینا بیشتر به دنبال پول آسان و آبجوی ارزان است تا محافظت از قلمرو. اما وقتی پادشاهی توسط شر تهدید می‌شود، این گروه پر سر و صدا متوجه می‌شوند که تنها کسانی هستند که قادر به بازگرداندن عدالت هستند.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: They're rowdy, they're ragtag, they're misfits turned mercenaries for hire. Vox Machina is more interested in easy money and cheap ale than actually protecting the realm. But when the kingdom is threatened by evil, this boisterous crew realizes that they are the only ones capable of restoring justice. What began as a simple payday is now the origin story behind Exandria’s newest heroes.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After saving the realm from evil and destruction at the hands of the most terrifying power couple in Exandria, Vox Machina is faced with saving the world once again—this time, from a sinister group of dragons known as the Chroma Conclave.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In Season 3, the Chroma Conclave's path of destruction spreads like wildfire while the Cinder King hunts down Vox Machina. Our lovable band of misfits must rise above inner (and outer) demons to try and save their loved ones, Tal'Dorei, and all of Exandria

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: A year after the Chroma Conclave, Vox Machina has separated, searching for love, family and purpose. But as always, the call of adventure is a breath away. When a long-slumbering evil awakens to threaten the realm, they must reunite to take on an epic foe.

title: The Legend of Vox Machina
